en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 320 - Abu Nasr Hibtullah Ibn Muhammad bin Ahmad says in a narration:

The tomb of Uthman Ibn Saeed is on the western side of Baghdad in the Maidan Street. It is in the beginning of the famous place known as the gate of Hubla, in the gate of the Mosque on the right side. The tomb itself is opposite the mosque.
